provenance.tool: property test; tests/reference/derive_cashflows.py (Python 3.13 standard library: fractions, decimal)
provenance.steps: Fixture: the SCN-BASE-01 book and settings. views: loans B1 and B7 under parallel shocks of -200bp, 0 and +200bp: for B1 incentive 0.03, 0.01 and -0.01, so k (I - x0) = 2, 0 and -2; for B7 0.075, 0.055 and 0.035, so 6.5, 4.5 and 2.5; CPR = (0.02 + 0.28 logistic) x Ramp(age) x Season(month), exp in decimal at 60 digits. Property: in each trial PM1 parameters and margin are drawn from the seeded generator and a shock of 1 to max_shock_bp basis points; every shocked rate stays at or above 0, so the post-shock floor, which is at most 0, cannot bind. For every loan and projected month CPR(up) <= CPR(BASE) <= CPR(down). The property is checked loan by loan: a pool CPR weights loans by balances that differ between scenarios. Negative control: with up and down exchanged the comparison fails in every trial.
